title: The roadmap build refuses a step file whose slug left while a lane still names it
why: Triage renamed resume-guard-subagent-sends at 10:25 CST Nov 8 on a lane's ask; the rename orphaned its lanes' cs-step tags, and 41 lanes already read unknown for missing or renamed step files (coordinator audit 10:30 CST).
note: Filed 10:36 CST Nov 8 by triage for its own mistake (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard). Rename undone in a032cf194. Fix: roadmap/build.py compares the step slugs against the previous commit and refuses a removed slug that a lane or session tag still names. Related: idle-lane-steps-unknown (ready).
